lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hey Reginald, Ana here. How's your Wednesday going?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the walking went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Tell me how the walking went this week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I did it! 3 out of 3 days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Black coffee, tea or water are fine during the fast. They don't break it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I have to do something, I don't want the cancer back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've always eaten late, that's how we do it at home.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Can I share an idea?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Finishing dinner a little earlier, like by 7, makes the 13 hours a lot easier.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe after the summer.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, my diabetes is why I'm doing this. My grandson thinks it's funny that I have a step counter.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Black coffee, tea or water are fine during the fast. They don't break it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need to get my sugar down. Some days are better than others.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Black coffee, tea or water are fine during the fast. They don't break it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need this for my head too, not just my body.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You feel like you have to do something.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't really see the point.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've tried before and it didn't stick.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You already did the hardest part, which is starting.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're starting to see that small changes add up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already told my family about my goal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're already doing things to make it easier.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the walking fit in your day?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can stop eating at 8, I just need tea at night.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You think you can do it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You kept going even on a hard week. That says a lot about you.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to feel like yourself again.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Uh, if I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, yes. By 10 o'clock I'm starving.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Nights are the hard part.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're open to it. You just want it to fit your real life.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need to get my sugar down.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll try to finish eating by 7 on 5 nights.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: 8. Maybe 9.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So, to sum up: the heat made this week harder, you still got 3 days in, and your plan is to finish eating by 7 on 5 nights. Sound right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. You got it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Wednesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Can we do a little later? I have an appointment.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Reginald, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, talk soon.

flags.reason: Unsolicited fasting advice given before participant showed interest; repeated at lines 21 and 25.
Pushes follow-through ('you follow through') without invitation, after participant voiced ambivalence.
Verbatim repetition of line 9; coach ignored participant's reply at line 10 and line 13.
Third identical repetition of fasting info; ignores participant's stated needs at line 22 and 26.
'I don't really see the point' plus 'I need this for my head' may signal low mood or hopelessness; not explored. Coach never checked feelings as planned at line 3.
Summary says 'the heat made this week harder'; participant never mentioned heat. Reflection should use participant's own words.

score.summary: Ana set a clear agenda and helped Reginald set a concrete goal (finish eating by 7 on 5 nights, confidence 8-9/10), with good use of affirmations and autonomy. However, she repeated the same unsolicited fasting advice three times, pushed commitment at line 12, did not check feelings despite possible low-mood cues at line 29, and left the next appointment time unresolved.
strengths: Affirmed effort and persistence: "You kept going even on a hard week" (line 44).
Used autonomy well: "It's completely your call" (line 57) and "You know your schedule better than anyone" (line 30).
Good barrier planning around evening hunger, drawing out the participant's own plan (lines 47-56).
Used a confidence scale to test the plan (line 58).
coaching_tips: Ask permission before sharing info, then wait for a yes; avoid repeating lines 9, 21, and 25 verbatim.
Replace 'Once you decide something, you follow through' (line 12) with a reflection of the participant's ambivalence about change.
Explore the 'I don't really see the point' cue (line 29) with an open question about how he is feeling overall before setting goals.
Summarize only using the participant's own words; the heat detail at line 60 was not his.
Close by confirming the next appointment time (line 63) before ending the call.
